description:
You're listening to the official audio for Otis Redding - "Try a Little Tenderness" from the album 'The Dictionary Of Soul'. "Try a Little Tenderness" is on Rolling Stone's list of the greatest songs of all time and is sampled in "Otis" by JAY Z and Kanye West.
